items.summary: Wall Street sees booming cloud growth as a sign that AI spending is giving a return on investment.

items.title: Meta to face massive social media addiction trial Tuesday
items.summary: A lawsuit filed by 29 attorneys general related to Meta's impact on teens will go to trial Tuesday.

items.title: At AI-Fueled Market Party, Wall Street Eyes the Rates Punch Bowl
items.summary: Enthusiasm for Big Tech and its huge investments in artificial intelligence is powering the stock market to record highs again. With a resilient economy and scorching demand, there’s seemingly only one obstacle that can derail this ride: higher interest rates.

items.title: 2 Profitable Stocks with Exciting Potential and 1 We Turn Down
items.summary: Even if a company is profitable, it doesn’t always mean it’s a great investment. Some struggle to maintain growth, face looming threats, or fail to reinvest wisely, limiting their future potential.

Management highlights the profit milestone and Meta agreement as key steps in reshaping Newsmax's operating model. items.title: Bond Traders Are Agonizing Over $70 Billion of Shadow Credit Backstops For AI Companies
items.summary: Even before Nvidia Corp.’s splashy $500 billion financing partnership this week, investors were starting to fret over the roughly $70 billion in phantom liabilities that don’t appear on major AI companies’ balance sheets, but could materialize at the worst possible time.

items.title: The 5 Biggest Risks Americans Don’t Think About Behind the Data Center Boom
items.summary: Half a trillion dollars in AI infrastructure spending looks like a Wall Street windfall, but the hidden costs are landing somewhere else entirely, and most Americans have no idea they are already on the hook.
